title: Psyren TV Anime Reveals More Cast, Opening Theme Artist, October 5 Debut in Video
content:
The staff for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga revealed on Friday the show's October 5 debut in a new video. The staff also revealed more cast, the opening theme song artist, and a new key visual.

English-subtitled version

Non-subtitled version

CLAN QUEEN performs the opening theme song "Warning!!"

The new cast includes: Yūko Kaida as Matsuri Yagumo and Nobuyuki Hiyama as Dolkey.

The anime will debut on Tokyo MX and BS11 on October 4 at 11:00 p.m., before airing later that evening on Sun TV .

Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China.

The anime stars:

• Rikuya Yasuda as Ageha Yoshin

• Mayuko Kazama as Sakurako Amamiya.

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Hiryu Asaga

• Sōma Saitō as Oboro Mochizuki

• Yukihiro Nozuyama as Kabuto Kirisaki

Katsumi Ono ( Symphogear AXZ , Symphogear G , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V ) is directing the anime at Satelight . Shin Yoshida ( Naruto Shippūden , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! GX ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Akira Ōkuma ( Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ; Demon Lord, Retry! R ) is designing the characters. Composers include: Takashi Ōmama ( Mobile Suit Gundam Twilight AXIS , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , I Parry Everything ), and Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses ).

REMOW describes the anime:

One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

REMOW stated the anime will fully adapt the manga through its conclusion.

Iwashiro serialized Psyren in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2007-2010. Viz Media released all 16 volumes in English from 2011 to 2014.

title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 Reveals Main Trailer and Visual, October 7 Premiere With 1-Hour Special
content:
Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 will premiere on October 7, 2026, with a one-hour special episode, revealing a new main trailer and visual ahead of the broadcast. Tasuku Hatanaka and Yu Sasahara are also joining the cast, while MADKID will perform the opening theme “Unbroken.”

Season 2 will feature some notable staff changes. Yushi Ibe has been appointed director, with Yamato Ochi serving as assistant director. Series composition returns to Deko Akao, while Saori Nakashiki takes over as character designer. Animation production will once again be handled by SILVER LINK. MADKID’s “Unbroken” is previewed in the new trailer, which you can watch below.

Studio SILVER LINK also animated the first season, which ran for a total of 12 episodes from January to March this year. Season 2 was announced at Anime Japan 2024 quickly afterwards, and the announcement trailer featured the opening song “FLY” by MADKID.

Check out the new visual below.

Season 2’s full staff includes:

• Director: Yushi Ibe

• Assistant Director: Yamato Ochi

• Series Composition: Deko Akao

• Character Design: Saori Nakashiki

• Chief Animation Directors: Saori Nakashiki, Yuki Sawairi

• Action Supervisor: Kazunori Ozawa

• Director of Photography: Yuko Shintani

• Art Director: Yuki Shinjo

• 3DCG Director: Tsutomu Ogasawara

• Color Design: Shiho Mizumoto

• Sound Director: Nobuyuki Abe

• Animation Production: SILVER LINK.

The Sasaki and Peeps light novel is written by Buncololi, with illustrations by Kantoku. It was first published as a web novel on the Kakuyomu and Shosetsuka ni Naro websites in December 2018, after which it was serialized under Media Factory’s MF Bunko J imprint in January 2021. There is also manga adaptation by Pureji Osho in Kadokawa Shoten’s Shonen Ace Plus , which also began in January 2021.

Yen Press has licensed both the Sasaki and Peeps light novel and manga in English, while Crunchyroll streams the anime. The latter describes the story: Sasaki is a middle-aged office worker living in Japan. Feeling drained by the vapid corporate world, he heads to the pet shop in search of a new companion. There he finds an adorable bird named Peeps and takes him home. But Sasaki quickly learns that Peeps isn’t your average bird…he’s a powerful mage from another world! Together, they embark on a magical adventure filled with swords and sorcery.
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Ao to Midori BL Series Unveils Theme Song Artists, Visual
content:
The official website for the live-action series of Roji 's Ao to Midori (Ao and Midori) boys' love manga presented a new visual and the opening theme song artist for the series on Thursday. The group ONE N’ ONLY performs the series' opening theme song "Crush On You."

The manga centers on the titular characters Ao a nd Midori. Ao excels at both sports and academics at his high school, but is so innocent his nickname at school is "baby." Midori is in love with Ao, but due to various issues he is unable to be honest, and the two have a "mutual unrequited love." During their high school years, they are both imprisoned by the framework of "normalcy" and are unable to convey their feelings for each other. Throughout the next eight years, as they move on from high school and become working adults, they slowly deepen their relationship.

The series stars Naoya Kusakawa as Midori Yamamura and Hidekazu Chinen as Ao Hayama.

Nao Nomura (live-action Ayaka is in Love with Hiroko series), Hitomi Kitagawa, and Saki Michimoto are directing the series. Ayumi Shimo (live-action Ayaka is in Love with Hiroko series) is penning the scripts.

The series will premiere on the BS Asahi channel on October 5 at 11:24 p.m. (10:24 a.m. EDT), and will air on TV Kanagawa on October 5 at 11:30 p.m. The series will also air on HBC , RKB Mainichi Broadcasting , and CBC TV starting on October 8. The series will stream online first on Lemino starting on October 5 at 10:00 a.m., and will stream on TVer after the BS Asahi broadcasts.

France Shoin published the first volume in August 2023, and Printemps Shuppan published the second volume on May 28.

Roji 's Countdown to Yes boys-love manga previously inspired a live-action television series that debuted in January. Animate International publishes the manga in English and also publishes Roji 's All About My Two Dads manga in English.

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! Anime Reveals Staff, New Visual
content:
The official website for the television anime of author Kennoji and artist R_ringo 's My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! ( Dōkyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishō ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu ) manga revealed a new visual and the anime's staff on Friday.

Masayoshi Nishida ( Princess Knight , Little Astro Boy , Makina-san’s a Love Bot?! ) is directing the anime at Wolfsbane and Lightbox. Noriyoshi Sasaki is the series' technical director. Yōhei Kashii ( TenPuru , My One-Hit Kill Sister , Makina-san’s a Love Bot?! ) is in charge of series scripts. Ichirō Tanaka is designing the characters, with Ayame Etō and Yusho Hayakawa are the sub-character designers. Hayakawa is also the chief animation director. 12sound is composing the music.

Kazuki Kuwahara is directing the sound. Kumiko Yoshikawa is designing the props, weapons, and small objects. Norifumi Nakamura is directing the art. Fuyuto Muraguchi is the color key artist. Kōhei Ogawa is the compositing director of photography at Gekkō . Nao Kawakami is editing, and is also credited for production supervision. Atomu Saegusa (also known as Takatora Shiomi ) is credited for setting development. Kōhei Motokawa is the animation producer.

Seven Seas Entertainment describes the series:

One Man's desire to become strong leads him to a powerful Sword Saint. While she's got plenty of physical prowess and strength, her ditzy personality and stunning looks make her hard to resist! A fun and sexy rom-com manga that will get your blood flowing. Her stats? Stacked. Her power? Unmatched. Her looks? Deadly gorgeous. There's no better mentor to have than Liza Parsandra, a powerful Sword Saint, and Eugene Dawson is the lucky man chosen to be her trainee! But living and training with someone like Liza has unique challenges, especially when it comes to her scatterbrained nature. Between Liza's ditzy moments and tendency towards skinship while training, Eugene has a hard time focusing on the right sword when he's constantly in contact with the beautiful swordswoman!

WWWave Corporation 's Deregula anime label is producing the anime.

The manga launched on the KadoComi website in March 2024. The second volume shipped on January 23.

Seven Seas Entertainment announced at Anime Expo in July it has licensed the manga.

Seven Seas Entertainment will release the manga starting in June 2027 as part of its Ghost Ship imprint.

Kennoji 's other works include: Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist , The Girl I Saved on the Train Turned Out to Be My Childhood Friend , I Time-Traveled and Confessed to Ｍy Teacher Crush , and Hazure Skill . Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist inspired a television anime in July 2021.

title: 'Optimus Prime: Awakening' Animated Short's Clip Posted
content:
The official YouTube channel for the Transformers franchise posted a new 30-second clip from the 12-minute " Optimus Prime: Awakening " animated short on Thursday. (The clip is restricted from playing in Japan.)

The short will play after the ending credits in anniversary screenings of Fathom Entertainment and Hasbro 's upcoming 4K re-release of The Transformers: The Movie in theaters.

The late Peter Cullen stars as Optimus Prime in his final performance. Frank Welker stars as Megatron/Soundwave.

Josh Wassung is directing the short based on a script by Ryan Parrott . Bobby Krlic is composing the music and The Third Floor is animating the short.

The 4K re-release will open in theaters on September 17 in the United States, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Mexico, Germany, France, Singapore, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Panama, and Peru.

Fathom Entertainment describes The Transformers: The Movie :

For millennia, the heroic Autobots, led by Optimus Prime ( Peter Cullen ), have been at war with the evil Decepticons, led by Megatron ( Frank Welker ). As the battle between the Autobots and Decepticons rages on Earth, an even greater threat looms. Unicron ( Orson Welles , Citizen Kane), a colossal converting planet who consumes everything in his path, is heading for Cybertron to devour the Transform ers homeworld and wipe the Autobots and Decepticons from existence. The only hope is the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. With new enemies hunting them down and dangers lurking in every corner of the galaxy, the Autobots take on a perilous mission to save their planet that will alter their destiny forever.

Some theaters in the U.S. will feature collectible popcorn buckets and drinkware.

The companies previously re-released The Transformers: The Movie in U.S. theaters in September 2021 for the 35th anniversary of the franchise . Shout! Factory released a 35th anniversary steelbook limited edition for the film in August 2021. The release featured the film on 4K UHD for the first time, with a brand-new 4K transfer of the original 35mm film.

Toei Animation animated the 1986 film as a sequel to the first animated television seasons of The Transformers . The animated series is based on Hasbro 's toy line, which itself imported toys from Takara's Diaclone and Microman toy lines, among others.

Optimus Prime's voice actor Cullen died on August 26 at his home in Los Angeles. He was 85.

title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades Game Launches on February 4
content:
Marvelous announced on Thursday that Muramasa: Revenant Blades , an enhanced edition of Vanillaware's Muramasa: Rebirth and Muramasa: The Demon Blade games, will debut on February 4 for PlayStation 5, Switch, Switch 2, and PC via Steam .

Marvelous also posted a nearly 10-minute-long gameplay video for the game on Thursday.

The game will be the first ever Vanillaware game to be released on PC.

Marvelous describes the story:

Deep in Japan's past, a great conflict erupts over the ownership of fabled and powerful samurai swords forged by the legendary Senji Muramasa. These swords grant their owner both incredible power and a madness that can be sated only by blood. As various factions clash over these mythical weapons, demons and evil spirits drawn to the bloodshed rampage across the land. These fables explore the fates of six diverse characters whose lives are thrown into chaos by these revenant blades.

The new release for the sidescrolling action RPG features 4K visuals, new English voiceover and localization, and new modes.

The game includes the original protagonists Momohime and Kisuke, as well as the characters from the PlayStation Vita port Muramasa: Rebirth : Okoi, Gonbe, Arashimaru, and Rajaki. Players can experience the six storylines in any order.

Muramasa: The Demon Blade originally debuted for Nintendo Wii in 2009. The game's PS Vita port Muramasa: Rebirth launched in 2013. The port added four characters in a DLC titled "Genroku Legends."

These fables explore the fates of six diverse characters whose lives are thrown into chaos by these revenant blades.
The new release for the sidescrolling action RPG features 4K visuals, new English voiceover and localization, and new modes.

The game includes the original protagonists Momohime and Kisuke, as well as the characters from the PlayStation Vita port Muramasa: Rebirth : Okoi, Gonbe, Arashimaru, and Rajaki. Players can experience the six storylines in any order.
Muramasa: The Demon Blade originally debuted for Nintendo Wii in 2009. The game's PS Vita port Muramasa: Rebirth launched in 2013. The port added four characters in a DLC titled "Genroku Legends."

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime From Dandadan’s Studio Already Has a Finale Date
content:
The fall anime season is less than a month away, and the lineup is more exciting than ever with the return of Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and some of the most anticipated series. The upcoming season also has a list of anime series lineup for this season. However, before the Fall 2026 anime series are released, fans will have to bid farewell to the Summer 2026 series. Summer was yet another exciting quarter for fans thanks to Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Part 4, Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2, and more.

Among the exciting new series, one of them includes Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongoli a , a breakout hit from the same animation studio as Dandadan . Science SARU is known for its stunning visuals and critically acclaimed anime series and movies. The studio didn’t disappoint with its latest Crunchyroll anime, and it’s easily one of the best in recent years. This historical anime is based on an acclaimed manga series written and illustrated by Tomato Soup. Now that September is here, the anime will soon be ending its first season.

When Is Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Ending?

The anime will release the final episode of Season 1 on September 12, 2026. If you’re watching the dubbed episodes, you will be able to catch up on September 26, 2026. Crunchyroll anime usually have a two-week delay for dubbed episodes unless otherwise announced on the website. Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia premiered on July 4, 2026, and it was later confirmed for a 12-episode season.

The manga is still ongoing, so there’s a pretty good chance the anime will return with a sequel. However, any information on the sequel will only be revealed after the first season’s broadcast in Japan. Luckily, it’s one of the biggest anime series of the year , so there’s a high likelihood that it will return with more seasons in upcoming years. The first season is only laying down the foundation of the story, but Sitara’s journey is far more complex and even darker in the manga.

Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Is One of the Best Anime of the Year

Beneath the exceptionally stunning animation style, the series is much more complex and nuanced as it tackles some dark themes of war and slavery. The story is set in the 13th-century Mongol Empire, where a young girl named Sitara was chased out of her homeland after the death of her mother and ended up in a slave market. She was eventually picked up by a kind family of scholars who encouraged her to study.

After living with them for a few years, her life came crashing down once again when the Tus Militia fell at the hands of the Nomads. It didn’t take long for homes and lives to be destroyed by the Nomads, forcing Sitara to embark on a journey where she later becomes known as the Witch of Mongolia thanks to her advanced intellectual mastery of medicine and geometry.

title: 'Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Buncololi 's Sasaki to Pii-chan ( Sasaki and Peeps ) light novel unveiled additional cast, a second key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 7 at 10:00 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX and BS Nippon Television, with the first episode broadcasting as a one-hour special.

Voice actors Tasuku Hatanaka ( SK∞ ) and Yuu Sasahara ( Shadows House ) are joining the cast as Himegami-kun and Eriel, respectively.

Kouji Fujimoto ( Bukiyou na Senpai. ) (Sus4 Inc.) and Osamu Sasaki ( Saikin Yatotta Maid ga Ayashii ) are composing the music. Kadokawa is credited for music production.

Music group MADKID ( Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari ) is performing the opening theme "Unbroken," which previewed in the first promotional video below.

Yuushi Ibe ( Tearmoon Teikoku Monogatari ) is directing the second season at SILVER LINK , with Yamato Oouchi ( Soredemo Ayumu wa Yosetekuru episode director) serving as assistant director. Deko Akao ( Buta no Liver wa Kanetsu Shiro ) is handling the series composition. Saori Nakashiki ( Kekkon Yubiwa Monogatari ) is designing the characters.

Produced by SILVER LINK, the first season aired in 12 episodes in Winter 2024. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles and later streamed an English dub.

Buncololi began penning the novel on the Kakuyomu website in December 2018. Kadokawa began publishing the series under its MF Bunko J label in January 2021, featuring illustrations by Kantoku ( Hentai Ouji to Warawanai Neko. ). The 13th volume was released on March 25.

Shounen Ace Plus began serializing a manga adaptation by Oshou Pureji in January 2021. Kadokawa published the sixth volume on June 26.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga in English and released the tenth light novel volume on August 11. The fourth manga volume went on sale in December 2025, with the fifth volume planned for an October 27 release.

PV 1

title: Jujutsu Kaisen & Attack on Titan Studio Drops Cool New Trailer for Big Anniversary
content:
Established in 2011, MAPPA slowly climbed through the ranks to become one of the biggest animation studios in Japan. After five years of releasing critically acclaimed series and movies, the studio had its breakthrough year in 2016 with the premiere of Yuri!!! on Ice . MAPPA has been on the rise ever since then with the release of Banana Fish and more incredible anime. However, its success truly hit the top with the premiere of Jujutsu Kaisen . It’s easily the biggest anime from the studio, and since then, MAPPA’s success has been phenomenal. The animation studio also released some exceptional series such as Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan Final Season , and more.

MAPPA is commemorating its 15th anniversary this year, with several surprises planned for fans. The anniversary celebrations have been going on for months, and there’s still a while before the studio wraps it up. One of the projects includes the 15th anniversary MAPPA Expo, the largest exhibition held by the studio. As the exhibition draws near, the studio dropped an exciting new trailer for fans.

What to Know About the 15th Anniversary MAPPA Expo

The exhibition will include 23 featured titles , including Jujutsu Kaisen and some of the most beloved anime series and movies for fans. Life-size figures and insight into the anime’s production will be on display, and visitors can also buy merchandise based on exclusively new content. The exhibition is split into two phases, and the first one is closer than ever as it opens on September 16, 2026. Phase one will close on October 25, 2026, before the Expo returns with the second phase from October 28 to December 7.

The scale of this exhibition is something fans have yet to witness, and they’re all experienced so far. The trailer features some of the most hyped scenes from its biggest titles along with a first look at the figures inside the expo. Additionally, for several weeks now, MAPPA has been releasing new visuals on the expo’s official X handle to promote the event. Tickets are available on the official website . However, the exhibition will only take place in Japan, and there is little to no chance of it happening outside of the country.

MAPPA Has Several Ongoing Projects in the Works

The animation studio held a special event in June this year to announce updates on its ongoing projects as part of the anniversary celebrations. Sure enough, the event was a massive success as it revealed new looks at not only some of the most anticipated sequels, but also the new series they’re working on. Most of the upcoming sequels include Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4, Chainsaw Man: Assassins Arc , Ranma 1/2 Season 3, Dorohedoro Season 3, and more.

On the other hand, Hell’s Paradise, another major Shonen series from the studio, still hasn’t been greenlit for a third season. Additionally, the studio is also working on new series, including Fall in Love, You False Angels , which grabbed everyone’s attention thanks to its gorgeous art style. If that’s not all, MAPPA has also partnered with Netflix for more anime like Jimoto Saiko and Beat & Motion . 2027 is going to be the biggest year for anime fans thanks to the several exciting surprises from the studio.
